title: Financial Planning and Analyst
description:
Job title: Financial Planning and Analyst
  
  
Location: Bawal
  
  
At Johnson Matthey, your work will matter. As a Financial Planning and Analyst, you’ll join a world leader in platinum group metals with over 200 years of history and innovation. You’ll help tackle the world’s biggest challenges - cutting emissions, powering modern society and enhancing lives - as we continue to apply, refine and recycle metals that matter, for a healthier and more resilient future.
  
  
**The role:**
As a Financial Planning and Analyst, you will help drive our goals by:
  
  
Prepare reports, forecasts, and budgets, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and adherence to financial guidelines and accounting standards.
  
  

* Provide financial analysis, including variance analysis, trend analysis, and profitability analysis, to identify key performance drivers, risks, opportunities.
* Support the business to drive and improve performance, this includes running and delivering first line analysis, participating in drawing conclusions on changes required.
* Participate in preparing presentations and reports for key stakeholder groups (Business Partners, Senior Management), highlighting financial performance, trends, and potential risks
* Participate in compiling and analyzing data to support the preparation for business performance reviews and business results commentary.
* Participate in the development and improvement of financial models, tools, and processes to enhance financial planning and analysis capabilities.
* Participate in cross-functional projects and initiatives, providing financial expertise and guidance to support business growth, process optimisation, and risk management.
* Perform continuous improvement initiatives to enhance financial planning and analysis capabilities, streamline processes, and improve data integrity and accuracy.

**Key skills that will help you succeed in this role:**

* Advance Excel
* Power BI
* SAP

**Required Qualification and Experience for this role:**

* Education - CA or CMA
* Experience - 6+ Years with with Strong financial, analytical and communication project management skills; Business orientation and interest.

Even if you only match some of the skills, we’d love to hear from you to discuss further!
  
  
**What we offer:**
We make sure salaries are fair, competitive and aligned to individual roles, experience and responsibilities. We are also supportive of hybrid and flexible working and where applicable, offer life, medical and other benefits that support our employees’ financial and physical wellbeing, such as:
  
  

* Competitive compensation and performance-based rewards.
* Comprehensive medical insurance.
* Life and accident insurance.
* Retirement benefits (Provident Fund & Gratuity).
* Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and wellbeing initiatives.
* Learning, development, and career progression opportunities.

**Ready to make a meaningful impact on your career and the environment? Join us and help shape a sustainable future while advancing your career!**
At JM, inclusivity is central to our values. We create an environment where everyone can thrive, embracing diverse perspectives to tackle challenges and ensure all colleagues feel valued and connected.
  
  
For any queries or accessibility requirements, please contact GlobalRecruit@matthey.com. We will work with you to make suitable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. All conversations are confidential, and your feedback is welcome to help us provide an accessible and positive recruitment experience.
  
  
Closing date for applications: This job advertisement will be posted for a minimum of 2 weeks; early application is advised.
  
  
#MyCareerMatters #CareersThatMatter
  
  
To submit your application, please click the "Apply" button online.
  
  
All applications are carefully considered and your details will be stored on our secure Application Management System. This is used throughout Johnson Matthey for the selection of suitable candidates for our vacancies as they arise. Johnson Matthey respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information.
  
  
For more information about how your personal data is used please view our privacy notice:  Johnson Matthey Privacy Notice. By applying for this role and creating an account you are agreeing to the notice.
  
  
Johnson Matthey Plc is an equal opportunities employer and positively encourages applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, religion or belief.

title: Articled Assistant
description:
**Company Description**
Jain Prerna & Co. is a professional accounting and advisory firm committed to delivering reliable, accurate, and timely financial services to individuals and organizations. The firm focuses on building long-term client relationships through integrity, transparency, and personalized service. Team members are encouraged to develop strong technical skills and professional judgment in a supportive learning environment. Jain Prerna & Co. offers exposure to a variety of assignments, helping aspiring professionals gain practical experience and grow in their careers.

**Role Description**
The Articled Assistant will work full time on-site at the Jain Prerna & Co. office in Sonipat. Day-to-day responsibilities include assisting with audits, tax return preparation, accounting entries, and financial statement compilation under the guidance of senior team members. The role involves maintaining working papers, supporting documentation, and client records in an organized and accurate manner. The Articled Assistant will also help in conducting basic financial analysis, complying with relevant standards and regulations, and coordinating with clients for data collection and clarification. This position provides hands-on training, exposure to professional ethics, and opportunities to learn firm procedures and best practices.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong basics in accounting principles, financial reporting, and taxation.
* Candidates should possess skills in using spreadsheets and accounting software, along with general computer literacy.
* Candidates should possess good analytical and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Candidates should possess effective written and verbal communication skills to interact with team members and clients.
* Candidates should possess time-management and organizational skills to handle multiple assignments and meet deadlines.
* Enrollment in or completion of a relevant professional course (such as CA or equivalent) is highly beneficial.
* Willingness to learn, maintain professional ethics, and work collaboratively in a team environment is essential.

title: Accountant
description:
**Company Description**
NTNNEI MANUFACTURING INDIA PVT LTD is an industrial manufacturing organization operating in India with a facility in Rewari. The company focuses on delivering reliable, high-quality manufactured products to domestic and international customers. It emphasizes operational efficiency, process discipline, and continuous improvement in its production and support functions. Team members are encouraged to contribute to streamlined workflows and robust compliance practices, especially in finance and accounting. The organization values professionals who support accurate financial reporting and strong internal controls to enable sustainable growth.
  
**Role Description**
The Accountant role is a full-time, on-site position based in Rewari. The individual in this role will handle day-to-day accounting activities, including posting journal entries, maintaining ledgers, reconciling bank and vendor accounts, and managing accounts payable and receivable. Responsibilities include preparing invoices, monitoring payments, assisting with monthly and annual closing, and supporting the preparation of financial statements and management reports. The Accountant will ensure compliance with relevant accounting standards, tax regulations, and internal policies, while coordinating with internal departments and external auditors as needed. The role also involves maintaining accurate documentation, supporting budgeting and cost tracking, and contributing to process improvements in the finance function.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong knowledge of general accounting principles, ledger maintenance, and account reconciliation.
* Ability to manage accounts payable and receivable, invoicing, billing, and cash/bank transactions.
* Experience in preparing financial reports, assisting with month-end/year-end closing, and supporting audits.
* Understanding of taxation, compliance, and statutory reporting relevant to manufacturing or industrial organizations.
* Proficiency with accounting software and MS Excel; familiarity with ERP systems is an advantage.
* Excellent attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and organizational skills.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related field; professional certifications (such as CA/CPA or equivalent) are a plus.
* Prior experience in an accounting role within a manufacturing or industrial environment is preferred.
